Anthony woke up at 6am.
Thomas saw Anthony attending class at the school from 6am to 2pm.

The park was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could Anthony have gone to the park?

Options:
(A) 2pm to 5pm
(B) 5pm to 8pm
(C) 6am to 2pm
(D) 8pm to 9pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- From 2pm to 5pm, Anthony was at the deli, so he couldn't have gone to the park during this time either.
- From 5pm to 8pm, Anthony was at the library, so he couldn't have gone to the park during this time.
- The park was closed after 9pm, so Anthony couldn't have gone to the park after that time.

The only time Anthony was not accounted for, and the park was open, was between 8pm and 9pm.

Answer: (D) 8pm to 9pm
